entries.gloss: bury = embed in earth — q/ɣ, r-s
might, back-strength (Quranic اشدد به أزري) — w/ʾ, s/z, r
hide = to become dark — d, g/j
to be sound, clean, whole — w-ḍ
to bind, swear an oath — ʿ + q/r
to repay, restore, replace — ḏ/j, b
harm, evil, torment — s/ʿ, ḏ, b
to be silent, still — s + g/k + r; Eg. sgr = silence
to blow, breath, wind — n-f; Eg. nfj = to blow
to fill, be full — m + ḥ/l; Eg. mḥ = to fill
to drive away, expel, subdue — ṭ/d-r; Eg. dr = drive away
to guard, be watchful, wake — r-s; Eg. rs = be vigilant/awake
to cry out, shout — ṣ-r-ḫ ↔ s-ḫ-r metathesis
to lift, carry up, support — f shared; Eg. fꜣj = carry/lift
to dig, hollow out — the digging; Eg. šꜣd = dig
enclosure, fold, coop — q/k-n; Eg. knm = enclosure
to hasten, serve, climb — ḥ-f-d EXACT (Quranic وحَفَدة)
to loosen, untie, release — f + ḫ/k
to crumble, break up, untie — f-t
to glimpse, catch sight — m-ḥ + g/l
to be just, level, fair — n-f
to pass by, travel, surpass — s
to be weak, fail, flag — w-h
to tread, trample, walk — d + g/ʿ + s
to transgress, be false, overstep — ʿ-d
to cut off decisively — ḥ-s + q/m
sinew, cord, the firm back — m-t
to excel, precede, be ahead — s-b-q EXACT
to be hot, heat — ḥ-m-m EXACT
to lose, diminish, be driven back — ḫ-s-r EXACT
shoulder, arm, right side — m-n + r/y
to wrap, swathe, shroud — f-n + ʿ/k
to be many, cover, overwhelm — ʿ/ɣ + š
to join, merge, touch, unite — d-m-j EXACT
to extinguish, quench, die down — ḫ-m
to establish, make firm, guarantee — s/ḍ + m-n
to judge, separate, restrain — w + ḏ/z + ʿ
word, speech (mdt) = the extended utterance — m-d
crocodile — m + s/z + ḥ (Arabic word is from Egyptian via Coptic)
to snatch, seize, smell — ḫ + p/f
primeval waters / the watery deep — n-w-n
to release, loosen → pardon — s/ṣ + f + ḫ/ḥ
